source.title: Banbridge Chronicle, 9 May 1908, p. 3 ("Armagh County Council"); Armagh Guardian, 8 May 1908, p. 6 ("Council Elections": withdrawals); nominations in the Newry Reporter, 2 May 1908, p. 10 ("Armagh County Council": the nominations)
source.publisher: Banbridge Chronicle (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the two papers, checked against the Newry Reporter nominations image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Returned unopposed. Two seats. W. R. Atkinson, W. Baxter, W. M. Clow, James Grew and W. H. Wright withdrew (Atkinson's nomination paper had also been declared invalid), leaving the sitting members, Johnston and Collen, both described as direct labour candidates, declared elected.
